#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    long long b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> a(n);
    vector<int> c(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> a[i];
        c[i] = (a[i] % 2 == 0) ? 1 : -1;
    }
    vector<long long> prefix(n);
    prefix[0] = c[0];
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        prefix[i] = prefix[i - 1] + c[i];
    }
    vector<long long> list;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
        if (prefix[i] == 0) {
            list.push_back(abs((long long)a[i] - a[i + 1]));
        }
    }
    sort(list.begin(), list.end());
    long long total = 0;
    int count = 0;
    for (long long d : list) {
        if (total + d <= b) {
            total += d;
            count++;
        } else break;
    }
    cout << count << endl;
    return 0;
}
